description: Edits any entry of the published app's community, live at once; only the fields passed change, but payload, tags and i18n are replaced whole. On a user's entry the author is notified. To reject, remove or suspend: neblla_moderate_community_entry.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

fields.description: Values of the community's own fields.

i18n.description: Title and summary in other languages; replaces the whole map, null clears it.

lang.description: The language of title and summary.

payload.description: Replaces the whole payload: send every key, not only the changed ones.

tags.description: The new tags; replace the list.

name: neblla_update_community_entry
title: Edit a community entry
